hero.summary_en: South African programme information is split between 4Racing and Race Coast, with both current operator systems now production-routed.
hero.summary_ja: 南アフリカの番組情報は4RacingとRace Coastに分かれており、現在は両operator体系をproduction routingしています。

paragraphs_en: Race Coast supplies its current KZN & Western Cape fixture mother set, while the jointly reviewed South Africa 2026 National Fixtures PDF supplies precise dates for the 4Racing Highveld & Eastern Cape scope. Both routes publish meeting date and physical racecourse at rank C.
paragraphs_ja: Race CoastはKZN・Western Capeの現行開催母表を提供し、4RacingのHighveld・Eastern Cape範囲は4RacingとRace Coastが共同レビューしたSouth Africa 2026 National Fixtures PDFから正確な開催日を取得します。両routeとも開催日と物理競馬場をCで公開します。

racing_types.name_ja: サラブレッド平地競走
racing_types.summary_en: The reviewed timetable routes are operator-specific.
racing_types.summary_ja: レビュー済み時刻表導線はoperator別です。

seasonality.summary_en: Use the Race Coast fixtures page for its four current venues and the jointly reviewed national fixture PDF for Turffontein, Vaal and Fairview.
seasonality.summary_ja: Race Coastの4会場は公式fixtures、Turffontein・Vaal・Fairviewは共同レビュー済みnational fixture PDFを使用します。

schedule.summary_en: Both current South Africa operator routes confirm meeting date and venue only; post times are not inferred.
schedule.summary_ja: 現在の南アフリカ両operator routeは開催日と会場のみを確認し、発走時刻は推測しません。

surfaces.summary_en: Surface claims are not normalized across operators in this batch.
surfaces.summary_ja: このbatchではoperator間の馬場情報を共通化しません。

systems.summary_en: 4Racing's Turffontein, Vaal and Fairview mother set is production-routed from the jointly reviewed 2026 National Fixtures PDF.
systems.summary_ja: 4RacingのTurffontein・Vaal・Fairview母表は、共同レビュー済み2026 National Fixtures PDFからproduction routingしています。

systems.summary_en: Race Coast provides the current KZN & Western Cape fixture calendar.
systems.summary_ja: Race CoastがKZN・Western Capeの現行開催日程を提供します。

calendar_guidance_en: Use separate production routes for the two current operator systems: Race Coast official fixtures for KZN & Western Cape, and the jointly reviewed national fixture PDF for 4Racing's Turffontein, Vaal and Fairview scope.
calendar_guidance_ja: 現在の2 operator体系は別routeで扱います。KZN・Western CapeはRace Coast公式fixtures、4RacingのTurffontein・Vaal・Fairviewは共同レビュー済みnational fixture PDFを使用します。
coverage_note_en: Current production support covers both current South Africa operator systems at rank C for meeting date and physical racecourse; race times remain out of scope.
coverage_note_ja: 現在のproduction対応は南アフリカの2つの現行operator体系を開催日・物理競馬場のCでカバーします。発走時刻は対象外です。

triggers_en: Race Coast fixture route or operator scope change
National fixture PDF version or venue-code change
triggers_ja: Race Coast開催導線・運営範囲変更時
National fixture PDFのversion・会場code変更時
